in_marathi.name: Venkata
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth, prosperity and wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Venkata हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Venkata is derived from the name of the Goddess 'Venkateswara', who is believed to be the preserver of the universe in Hindu mythology. The name is considered auspicious and is believed to bring wealth, prosperity and wisdom to the one who bears it. In the Bhagavad Gita, Lord Krishna is also referred to as 'Venkata' as he is the preserver of the universe.
